name: Draconid

traits.name: Scales
traits.description: +8 natural Defense as a twelfth, unremovable armor piece with its own item level 1–10 (XP from hits absorbed, 2 × D per hit): +2% per level, affinity lines at 3 / 6 / 9 (+5% reduction vs the family absorbed most), level 10 Awakened: +12 Defense and the Frost weakness softens to ×1.15. No durability.

traits.name: Breath
traits.description: Innate, once per fight, weight 1,000, no pool cost: a Fire cone for 1.0 × Attack (physical or spell, whichever is higher) to every enemy in the front row, applying Burn. Ranks by use like a skill (10 × D per use); Mastery line open.

effects.note: an innate action outside the loadout: once per fight, weight 1000, cost 0; Attack = max(attackPhys, attackSpell); ranks by use (10 × D per use) with the +4%/rank curve; Mastery line open

traits.name: Dark-steady Aim
traits.description: As the Orc: ignores the hero Accuracy penalty in Dark and Pitch light.

traits.name: Cold-blooded
traits.description: Frost damage ×1.25 (Chill and Freeze apply normally); −10% to all XP; −5 base Speed.

creationBlurb: The scaleborn. Armored skin that grows, and one breath of fire per fight.
